notes.text: Explicitly gives Elazar son of Yose transmitting Rav Avin.
The exact passage is at 1:2 in the digital division. It quotes Tanchum bar Chiyya, distinct from nearby Rabbi Tanchum bar Chaninah.
The separate reverse report is not pinned in the cited passages. Read both named Maasrot contexts and distinguished their Tanchum and Avin/Avun forms.
The genealogical emendation remains tentative. Both cited occurrences name Elazar’s father Yose without a further patronym. Avin is named as reported authority at 2:1.
